name: Unsupervised Decomposition and Enhancement in NeRF
definition: A method to decompose the view-dependent color c into a view-dependent lighting component v and a view-independent reciprocal color basis r, then enhance v using a neural network to produce an enhanced image Ie without ground truth supervision.
summary: Unsupervised Decomposition and Enhancement in NeRF decomposes view-dependent color into lighting and color components, enhancing images without ground truth by leveraging 3D geometry and multi-view consistency.
